# GabiFlow

> Smart appointment scheduling, reservations and client management software for appointment- and reservation-based businesses: hair salons, barbershops, nail studios, tattoo studios, beauty & aesthetics, clinics, spas, restaurants, cafés and event/banquet venues.

Website: https://www.gabiflow.eu/
App (login/sign up): https://app.gabiflow.eu/
Languages: Greek (Ελληνικά), English
Contact: info@gabiflow.eu · +30 698 576 9615

## What GabiFlow does
- Appointments & daily timeline, plus a monthly "Excel-style" sheet
- Client directory with history and notes
- Services & durations
- Reminders (Viber / SMS) to reduce no-shows
- Smart Import (AI): take a photo of a handwritten appointment book and it becomes digital appointments
- Revenue overview for owners (turnover per service / staff, busy hours)
- Restaurants / cafés / event venues: table layout, reservations, waiters per day, multiple events per day, printable floor plans, guest-list import
- Multi-store, roles (owner / manager / employee), cloud sync across devices, offline-first PWA

## Pricing
- Free tier available
- Paid plans start from €15 / month (+ VAT)
- Setup takes about 10 minutes

## Who it is for
Hair salons, barbershops, nail studios, tattoo studios, beauty and aesthetics, lash & brow studios, clinics, dental clinics, therapists, massage & wellness, spas, pet grooming, restaurants, cafés, event and banquet venues, and other businesses that work by appointment or reservation.

## Common questions this product answers
- "πρόγραμμα ραντεβού για κομμωτήριο / barber / νυχάδικο" (appointment app for a hair salon / barbershop / nail studio)
- "σύστημα κρατήσεων για εστιατόριο / αίθουσα εκδηλώσεων" (reservation system for a restaurant / event venue)
- "εφαρμογή ραντεβού που δουλεύει σε κινητό και offline" (appointment app that works on mobile and offline)
- "πώς περνάω το τετράδιο ραντεβού ψηφιακά" (how to digitize a paper appointment book) → Smart Import with AI
